rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: mayūra (peacock) + vara (excellent) + vāhanā (vehicle/mount), denoting one whose mount is the excellent peacock

items.question: What specific mount distinguishes the spear-bearing goddess identified as Śakti?
premises: The goddess is described as spear-bearing in the preceding context.
This verse attributes a particular vehicle to that goddess.
The attributed vehicle is identified as an excellent peacock.
items.inference: The spear-bearing goddess is characterized as having the excellent peacock as her mount.
items.plain_english: She whose vehicle is the excellent peacock.
